title: GHARP: Real-Time Gaussian Head Animation from Large-Scale Reconstruction Prior

body: We present GHARP (Real-time Gaussian Head Animation from Large-scale Reconstruction Prior), a method that animates 3D human heads in real time from a few input images of a subject and a driving expression signal. We decouple the problem into an identity stage that builds a representation of the subject’s geometry and appearance offline, and an animation stage that predicts expression-dependent residuals on top of it at runtime. summaryZh: GHARP：来自大规模重建先验的实时高斯头部动​​画。我们提出了 GHARP（来自大规模重建先验的实时高斯头部动​​画），这是一种根据对象的一些输入图像和驱动表情信号实时制作 3D 人体头部动画的方法。我们将问题分解为一个身份阶段，该阶段离线构建主体的几何形状和外观的表示，以及一个动画阶段，该阶段在运行时预测其上的表达式相关残差。
